description: Asks which exact texts Database.OpenRecordset accepts as a SELECT over One, and with what error where it refuses: no FROM, one or several trailing semicolons, text after a semicolon, a leading semicolon, leading and internal tabs, CR and LF, non-ASCII spaces (U+00A0, U+3000, U+2003) as separators, lower case, a trailing keyword, # and -- and /* */ comment forms (including an unterminated one), empty and blank and semicolon-only text, a bare table name, parenthesised statements and sources, dangling commas, unbalanced parentheses and brackets, and an unterminated string. Each text is its own snapshot, followed by DBEngine.Errors. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
